data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Any run that invoked non-deterministic components\u2014external tool calls, real-world I/O, unseeded randomness, or reads from mutable external state\u2014must refuse resumption unconditionally. Only fully deterministic runs (pure computation over immutable inputs, all randomness seeded and recorded as events) are resumable. This is conservative: it refuses resumption even when a clean halt occurred, because the continuation after resumption may produce semantically different events than an uninterrupted run would have, and the append-only log cannot distinguish 'genuinely continued' from 'divergently restarted' events.","counterconditions":[{"case":"All non-deterministic operations were fully captured as events (tool call inputs and outputs, random seeds, external state snapshots), making the run effectively replayable and deterministic.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The system can prove that external state has not changed between halt and resumption (e.g., via content-addressed inputs or versioned external APIs).","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The resumption protocol explicitly marks resumed events with a 'resumption boundary' event, making the hybrid nature explicit rather than hidden\u2014some definitions of append-only identity may permit this.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The run is fully deterministic by construction (no I/O, no external calls, seeded RNG), so the non-determinism refusal does not apply.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Non-determinism means the event at position N+1 depends on external state that may have changed between halt and resumption. Even if the log is intact up to N, appending N+1 after resumption produces a log that is a valid chain but semantically incoherent: it represents a hybrid of two different runs stitched together. This violates the identity contract of the log\u2014the events do not represent a single coherent execution. Refusing resumption forces a fresh run, preserving log integrity.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
